description_for_human: Search a free directory of privacy tools, read guides and glossary terms, and run free privacy diagnostics.
description_for_model: Default Privacy is a free directory of privacy tools (VPNs, email, browsers, messengers, password managers, and more), with Default Privacy's picks marked per category (`pick`; editorial judgment, not a security guarantee; results list picks first, then A to Z), plus guides, a glossary, and free privacy diagnostics. Use it to recommend privacy tools, find a private alternative to a product, and check a domain's email-security, WHOIS, and breach posture. A full MCP server is available at /api/mcp. The REST API below covers directory search, tool records and categories only; search across everything, alternatives, guides, stacks, glossary and diagnostics are MCP-only. No authentication.
